open_answer_coding.label: Convenience and timely access
open_answer_coding.rule: Explicit convenient, nearby or handy access; time saving, quick service, class breaks, busy periods or urgent use. General usefulness alone was not enough.

open_answer_coding.label: Price and affordability
open_answer_coding.rule: Explicit prices, affordability, fair or reasonable pricing, or comparison with prices outside campus.

open_answer_coding.label: Specific food or drink purchases
open_answer_coding.rule: Explicit lunch, meals, food, snacks or drinks as a reason to use the store. Generic essentials or options were not counted.

open_answer_coding.label: Choice or freshness
open_answer_coding.rule: Explicit good choice or selection, or freshness. A general mention of food was not enough.

open_answer_coding.label: Forgotten or urgent items
open_answer_coding.rule: Explicit forgetting an item or needing the store in a pinch. A normal short break was not counted as an emergency.
